## How it works

- [statement] Pipelined prefetch engines in GPU memory controllers prioritize full BL32 transfers over chop commands during auto-regressive GEMV passes to maximize bus duty cycle. (high confidence) — https://www.jedec.org/standards-documents/docs/jesd239 · keywords: Burst Truncation and Pipelined Prefetch Stalls · also: https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/blackwell-memory-architecture

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Burst Chop mode (BC16) allows early termination of a 32-byte burst transaction to service an urgent pending read, but leaves high-speed PAM3 transceivers idle for 2 UI during turn-around. (high confidence) — https://www.jedec.org/standards-documents/docs/jesd239 · keywords: Burst Truncation and Pipelined Prefetch Stalls · also: https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/blackwell-memory-architecture
